meta.name: hyperframes-core
meta.description: The HyperFrames composition contract — build one renderable project. Use for composition structure, the `data-*` timing attributes, `class="clip"`, tracks, sub-compositions, variables, framework-owned media playback, deterministic-render rules, and validation. Also covers Tailwind projects and the STORYBOARD.md / SCRIPT.md plan formats. Read before writing composition HTML.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 组织好画面轨道与子合成,让项目如期渲染
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在做动画合成,想一次写对项目结构避免返工
copy.tagline_en: Organize tracks and sub-compositions to make your project render reliably
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're creating animated compositions and want to get the structure right without rework

howto.what: Claude 会按 HyperFrames 规则构建可渲染的 HTML 视频项目：用 data-* 属性标定时序、用 class="clip" 管理剪辑，遵守确定性渲染规则，并先看参考文档再写代码。
howto.when: 当你要新建或编辑 HyperFrames 合成（HTML 视频项目），或遇到 data-* 时序、子合成、验证规则等问题时触发。

say.text: 我的子合成模板要怎样写，才能让它接住父级的变量？
say.note: 它会给出带 template 和变量的组合示例。

say.text: 帮我检查合成 HTML 的 lint 和确定性渲染规则有没有问题。
say.note: 它会核对硬性约束并指出违规处。

howto.what_en: Claude builds a renderable HTML video composition per the HyperFrames contract: timing via data-* attributes, clips via class="clip", obeying determinism rules, and reading reference docs before writing code.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to create or edit a HyperFrames composition, or hit questions about data-* timing, sub-compositions, or validation rules.

say_en.text: Add this scene as a HyperFrames composition, starting at 3s for 2 seconds.
say_en.note: It will lay out the timeline with data-* rules.

say_en.text: How do I write a sub-composition template that takes parent variables?
say_en.note: It gives an example with template and variables.

say_en.text: Check my composition HTML against lint and determinism rules.
say_en.note: It verifies hard constraints and flags violations.
